domain: Reddit 问题求解、经验搜索与休闲浏览
scope: 区分有明确问题的主动使用与无特定结果的被动浏览；保留移动端体验和社区发现需求。
methodology: 逐段完整阅读原文后人工式语义判断；条目由评审模型编写，程序仅校验引用和序列化，不以关键词抽取代替理解。未读取技能、论文目标、tests、生成结果或既有评估。条目不是最终目标模型，不规定唯一层次或粒度。

intents.intent: 用真实、情境化的个人经验快速解决具体问题
intents.subject: 受访者
intents.exceptions: 个人经验被其认为大多可信，但承认任何网络信息非100%可靠

evidence.quote: I get personal experiences over facts
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: get more targeted results to the problem that I'm facing.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: get to authentic answers much faster.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 查城市活动、技术问题、职业升学等主题资料
intents.subject: 受访者
intents.conditions: 需要某类具体信息或代码帮助时
intents.exceptions: Halloween、LeetCode 等为实例，不限单一领域

evidence.quote: I browse my city's subreddit with keyword. Halloween
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: when I'm stuck on a problem or need like other inputs for a problem.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 在空闲时浏览感兴趣的社区内容以消遣和发现有趣事物
intents.subject: 受访者
intents.conditions: 没有预先定义问题且有闲暇时
intents.exceptions: 明确常无特定成果，不应强加所有浏览必须解决问题

evidence.quote: if I'm just browsing Reddit, just to look through my interesting subreddits, then there is no particular outcome.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: I might just open reddit and scroll to see something interesting.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 特定问题通过 Google 加 Reddit 定位帖子，再与帖子互动
intents.subject: 受访者
intents.exceptions: 普通浏览直接 reddit.com；不使用官方移动应用的偏好有体验原因

evidence.quote: I Google, the question. And then I put Reddit after that.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: it gives me all the relevant posts.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 根据个人兴趣跟随社区并获得贴合兴趣的帖子
intents.subject: 受访者
intents.conditions: 浏览首页和订阅社区时
intents.exceptions: 大量主题多变；不应把大学或CS设为唯一兴趣

evidence.quote: any post that comes on my feed is pretty tailored to my specifications.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 在恰当社区发求助帖取得建议或解决方案
intents.subject: 求助发帖者
intents.exceptions: 通常互动对象是帖子和社区，不是特定用户或管理员

evidence.quote: most of the posts that I've done are posts asking for advice.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: I usually interact with posts, I would say, and communities and post within communities.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 发布含标题、正文与所需格式或媒体的帖子
intents.subject: 发帖者
intents.exceptions: Markdown、图片、视频、链接、投票为可用表达方式，不全都必需

evidence.quote: Then I can add a title to my post, I can add a body to my post.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: You can also add images. You can add video, you can add links. You can add polls.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 按社区规则给帖子加标签以便合适的人筛选回答
intents.subject: 发帖者/回答者
intents.conditions: 社区要求标签或主题分类有帮助时
intents.exceptions: 只有部分社区强制标签；动物医生实例非全局固定类别

evidence.quote: some subreddits make it mandatory to add tags.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: they'll filter out only the dog posts, and they'll only interact with those posts.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 对帖子发表评论或回复特定讨论串
intents.subject: 参与者
intents.exceptions: 本人总体评论少；不能推为强社交交友目标

evidence.quote: you can either create a new comment, or you can reply to a thread of comments
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 用可信社区的管理减少低质、误导内容
intents.subject: 读者/社区管理者
intents.modality: 明确价值判断；管理细节属受访者认知
intents.exceptions: 可靠性取决于管理团队；不能完全排除坏回答

evidence.quote: if a community has a strong, a strong set of moderators, then the posts themselves are reliable.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: anything you find on the Internet is not 100% reliable.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 依据不同用途用户的产品评价作购买决策
intents.subject: 受访消费者
intents.exceptions: 重视比电商更均衡的体验和使用背景；不要求 Reddit 内交易

evidence.quote: you can also find people from varied backgrounds talking about the product.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: I've made a lot of purchase decisions because of reviews I've seen on Reddit.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 学习一般健康、运动等问题的经验
intents.subject: 受访者
intents.exceptions: 明确不建议具体健康问题依赖 Reddit，也未要求诊疗系统

evidence.quote: it's good for general health, related questions.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: for specifics I've not used it, nor do I suggest anyone to use it.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 移动端更快、更直观，并支持中途保留发帖草稿
intents.subject: 移动用户
intents.conditions: 手机发帖或使用应用时
intents.exceptions: desktop 可保存草稿；Android是本人场景，不断言所有设备完全一致

evidence.quote: The mobile platform is quite slow and clunky
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: you can't save it as a draft which you can do on desktop.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 在手机上清晰跟踪评论层次和讨论串
intents.subject: 移动读者/参与者
intents.exceptions: 已有 threads；问题是呈现直观性而非无评论能力

evidence.quote: you cannot keep track of comments intuitively on Mobile
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: the desktop version is much more clearly put out.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 按主动搜索或被动浏览选择合适内容密度
intents.subject: 受访者
intents.exceptions: 被动用 card，主动搜索用 compact；不是统一最佳视图

evidence.quote: I'm just using it as a passive activity, I prefer, like card mode
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: searching for something I prefer, like compact mode where I can see all relevant search results.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 按新帖、热门、趋势等标准排序浏览帖子
intents.subject: 使用者
intents.exceptions: 没有说明本人始终选某一排序

evidence.quote: you can sort posts by new by top by trending, rising.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 广告尽量不打扰阅读，必要时用屏蔽或付费获得无广告体验
intents.subject: 受访者
intents.modality: 明确偏好及条件性购买意向
intents.exceptions: 当前广告较隐蔽且已有 adblock，暂不迫切付费；不可写成广告严重毁坏体验

evidence.quote: it doesn't interfere with your post experience or your reading experience.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: in some scenario where ad block is not available, I would buy the premium tier.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 按个人偏好选择外观模式和布局版本
intents.subject: 使用者
intents.exceptions: light/dark、legacy/current 只是选项；受访者认为 current UX更好，legacy更快

evidence.quote: light mode, dark mode.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: There are customizations that are offered to tailor tailor. Your experience.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 用自然语言/生成式AI找到适合自己具体问题的细分社区
intents.subject: 求助者
intents.conditions: 不知道最合适 subreddit 时
intents.exceptions: 不是要求用AI直接编造问题答案；更精准社区仍无法完全消除坏回答

evidence.quote: a Gen. AI tool, to figure out what subreddit I should be accessing to ask my particular question
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: the answers I'd get would be better
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 在有限离线缓存范围内继续阅读已载入的 feed
intents.subject: 移动读者
intents.modality: 描述可用能力，需求强度不确定
intents.exceptions: 不能刷新、发布新帖或无限读取；受访者未明确请求扩展离线能力

evidence.quote: it will for sure save the existing posts.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: it won't allow you to make new posts, nor will it refresh the feed
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

background_candidates.reason: 是使用价值和自述信念，有信息可追溯的自我修正；未提出新的具体隐私机制。

evidence.quote: the USP. Of Reddit is anonymity
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: Figure out who you are based on your post history.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: I, personally, don't interact much via comments.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: additional features
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

unresolved: T021“never posted”随即自述曾发多个求助帖，应视为表述不整齐，不能断言从未发帖。
匿名性是受访者认知；其也说 Google 登录和历史可识别人，不能断言绝对匿名。
健康相关仅保留一般学习，受访者不建议依赖具体健康建议。
